dataset.name: SNAPMe
dataset.limitation: Licensed external phone photos, not owned product captures; development split only. A separately frozen holdout run is reported in snapme_recognition_holdout.json.

configuration.grading: strict normalized exact label or pre-approved alias match

semantic_adjudication.policy: One-to-one human judgment of non-exact predictions against independently approved visible labels; MATCH counts as correct, NO_MATCH counts as incorrect, and preparation/portion/hidden details remain excluded.

interpretation: Strict lexical F1 is a reproducible lower bound; completed one-to-one human semantic adjudication raises development F1 to 0.811. This is still development-only evidence. No prompt tuning or holdout claim follows from this run.
